data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2019 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 416.7m. Analysis of the claims development triangle shows a modest net adverse prior-year development of approximately GBP 5.5m (c.1.3% of opening reserves), driven primarily by deterioration in the 2017 underwriting year. The business experienced a series of 2019 natural catastrophe events (Australian floods, Hurricane Dorian, Typhoons Faxai and Hagibis) and large losses in Marine and former Property lines which influenced reserve activity; however reinsurance and retrocessional programmes materially mitigated net impact. Segmental concentration shows most gross outstanding liabilities are in reinsurance acceptances (treaty business).

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 31) per the prescribed diagonal comparison method. There is conflicting narrative on prior-year movement (the note states an "overall improvement of GBP 6.2m") which appears to reference a different basis (possibly net of reinsurance or a different aggregation). The triangle computation produced a small gross strengthening (~GBP 5.5m). RITC was not identified; if present it would distort triangle-based PYD. Where LOB movements were reported, they are derived from the gross claims outstanding per-line 2018 vs 2019 and may reflect both portfolio mix changes and reinsurance placement differences.
